AMZN.rationale: Amazon's franchise is high-quality and accelerating: Q2 2026 showed AWS revenue of $42.2B (+37% YoY, fastest in 18 quarters), total net sales of $200.6B (+20% YoY), and operating income of $27.5B (+43% YoY). The AI and chip businesses each exceeded $25B annual run rates growing triple-digit percentages, providing tangible evidence the massive capex cycle is generating returns. The balance sheet is a fortress (D/E 0.149, equity $369.6B) and operating cash flow is robust ($35.5B quarterly, 1.68x net income). However, the trailing PE of 33.4x produces a 3.0% earnings yield against a 10Y Treasury of 4.68% — a negative equity risk premium of ~168bp that demands sustained high growth to justify. TTM free cash flow has turned negative ($-7.6B) due to ~$200B annual capex, and the Q3 2025 operating margin compressed from 11.4% to 9.7% with a material operating-to-net-income divergence ($3.77B gap from non-operating gains). The Anthropic IPO catalyst (potential October 2026 at $1.2T valuation, Amazon owns 15-20%) and Q3 2026 guidance of $22.5B-$26.5B operating income provide near-term re-rating paths. Cloud competition is intensifying (Google Cloud +82%, Azure +43%). Net: excellent franchise with accelerating AI monetization, but valuation is not cheap relative to rates, FCF is negative, and the capex bet must convert. Score reflects strong fundamentals tempered by valuation discipline and FCF uncertainty.
key_factors: AWS revenue $42.2B in Q2 2026, +37% YoY, fastest growth in 18 quarters; AI and chip businesses each exceeded $25B annual run rates growing triple-digit percentages
Q2 2026 total net sales $200.6B (+20% YoY), operating income $27.5B (+43% YoY) — decisive beat confirming operating leverage despite heavy capex
Trailing PE 33.4x (range 28.2-39.0) with earnings yield of 3.0% vs 10Y Treasury at 4.68%, negative equity risk premium of ~168bp
TTM free cash flow turned negative at -$7.6B due to $66.1B YoY increase in property/equipment purchases; full-year capex plan ~$200B
Balance sheet fortress: equity $369.6B, debt $55.1B, D/E 0.149; operating cash flow $35.5B quarterly at 1.68x net income
Q3 2025 operating margin compressed to 9.7% from 11.4% in Q2, with $3.77B divergence between operating and net income from non-operating gains
Anthropic IPO potential October 2026 at $1.2T valuation; Amazon owns 15-20% and has $100B+ AWS commitments; Q2 captured $53.4B pre-tax gain
Q3 2026 guidance: operating income $22.5B-$26.5B vs $17.4B in Q3 2025, implying continued operating leverage
Cloud competition intensifying: Google Cloud +82% YoY to $24.8B, Azure +43% — AWS growth strong but gap narrowing
Stock at $235.50, down 10.5% over prior quarter, in lower third of 365-day range ($196-$278.56)

sources_cited.excerpt: AWS net sales increased 37% year-over-year to $42.2 billion… its fastest growth in 18 quarters
Exceeded a $25 billion annual revenue run rate for AWS's AI business, growing triple-digit percentages year-over-year
Free cash flow decreased to an outflow of $7.6 billion for the trailing twelve months, driven primarily by a year-over-year increase of $66.1 billion in purchases of property and equipment
